description: This file contains source code implementing URL normalization functions, encoding, and decoding utilities for the 'burl' module in the lighttpd server. It defines functions for percent-encoding, normalization, path simplifying, and other URL processing tasks.

methods.name: int burl_is_unreserved(const int c)
methods.description: Checks if a character is an unreserved URI component.

methods.name: int burl_normalize_basic_unreserved(buffer * b,buffer * t)
methods.description: Normalizes URL by encoding reserved characters and unreserved characters, preserving the query start position.

methods.name: int burl_normalize_basic_required(buffer * b,buffer * t)
methods.description: Normalizes URL by encoding reserved characters, handling UTF-8, and dealing with fragments.

methods.name: int burl_contains_ctrls(const buffer * b)
methods.description: Checks for control characters in a URL buffer.

methods.name: void burl_normalize_qs20_to_plus(buffer * b,int qs)
methods.description: Replaces '%20' with '+' in the query string part.

methods.name: int burl_normalize_path(buffer * b,buffer * t,int qs,int flags)
methods.description: Simplifies the URL path, removing dot segments '--.'

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ __attribute_noinline__ __attribute_pure__ int burl_scan_qmark(const buffer * const b)
methods.description: Finds the position of '?' in URL buffer.

methods.name: void burl_append(buffer * const b,const char * const str,const size_t len,const int flags)
methods.description: Appends string data to a buffer with optional encoding and transformations based on flags.

methods.name: void burl_append_encode_all(buffer * const b,const char * const str,const size_t len)
void burl_append_encode_nde(buffer * const b,const char * const str,const size_t len)
void burl_append_encode_psnde(buffer * const b,const char * const str,const size_t len)
int burl_normalize_basic_required_fix(buffer * b,buffer * t,int i,int qs)
void burl_offset_tolower(buffer * const b,const size_t off)
void burl_offset_toupper(buffer * const b,const size_t off)
